title: Dragonite May Have an Island—and One Survivor
premise: Two Pokédex accounts point to a Dragonite-only island, including one survivor Dragonite reportedly brought there.
audiencePromise: Trace the clues from ocean rescues to a hidden island populated solely by Dragonite.
openLoop: Did Dragonite rescue one man, or lead him somewhere no one else lives?
payoff: One account says Dragonite took a shipwrecked man to a remote paradise occupied solely by Dragonite.
engagementQuestion: Do you see a rescue, or a secret Dragonite island?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and curious. Stress island, survivor, and solely. Pause briefly before each reveal, then end invitingly.
